The discriminator is a machine learning model that takes a real image and tries to determine whether it is real or not. The goal of the generator is to generate images that the discriminator cannot distinguish from real images.

The architecture of GANs is typically divided into two sub-models: the encoder and the decoder. The encoder takes a real image and outputs a low-dimensional feature vector. The decoder takes the high-dimensional feature vector and outputs a synthetic image. The generator uses the output of the discriminator to learn the quality of the synthetic image.
